fields.label: Accounts Email
fields.description: Notified when an intake is sent to Accounts.

fields.label: Auto-post harvest revenue on submit
fields.description: Post the harvest recognition entry automatically when a Harvest Settlement is submitted.

fields.label: Harvest Proceeds Account (Bank/Cash)
fields.description: Debited with harvest sale proceeds; credited when subscribers are paid.

fields.label: Subscriber Harvest Payable Account
fields.description: Liability account holding the subscribers' 80% until paid out.

fields.label: Cultivation Commission Income Account
fields.description: Income account for Agrolocale's 20% share of harvest value.

fields.label: Payout company (sister company that pays subscribers)
Subscriber payouts are made by a sister company
fields.description: Tick when another company (e.g. Foodlocale) buys the harvest and pays subscribers on this company's behalf.

fields.label: Payout Company
fields.description: The company whose bank account the subscribers are paid from.

fields.label: Payout Bank Account
fields.description: Bank account in the payout company used to pay subscribers (e.g. Globus Foodlocale).

fields.label: This Company as Supplier
fields.description: How this company appears as a supplier in the payout company's books. Each payout reduces what the payout company owes it.

fields.label: Payable Account (payout company)
fields.description: Creditors account in the payout company that carries what it owes this company.

fields.label: Receivable Account (this company)
fields.description: Debtors account carrying what the off-taker owes for harvest. Left blank, the harvest invoice's own receivable account is used.

fields.label: Raise the matching purchase invoice in the payout company
fields.description: Creates the purchase side automatically, so the payout company carries the payable and the subscriber payouts can be set against it.

fields.label: Receiving Warehouse (payout company)
fields.description: Optional. Set this to bring the harvest into the payout company's stock. Leave blank to record the purchase without any inventory movement.
